0619230E8B2843A76A10613318EA307F: JAIN is back with Soul System, her fourth album, which is more direct, radical and incandescent than ever. For over 12 years, the French singer-songwriter has been cultivating a free-spirited brand of pop, fuelled by travel and experimentation. Blending electro, rock, funk and club music, Jain transforms dancefloors into playgrounds for exploration with an album that is free-spirited, sensual and fiercely alive.

Canadian band The Dead South will be taking their unmistakable sound to the four corners of the globe during their extensive international tour, the ‘Silence, Please World Tour’. This tour will showcase their fifth studio album, ‘Silence, Please’, due for release on 5 March 2027.

Darker, more intense, faster and more powerful than ever before, the band is pushing the boundaries of acoustic music with their signature blend of banjo, mandolin, cello and guitar. Their unique musical world fuses bluegrass traditions with the intensity of doom metal, enriched by sophisticated rhythms, spellbinding harmonies and rousing choruses. Renowned for their electrifying live performances and their resolutely original musical identity, The Dead South continue to forge their own path across the musical landscape. Recorded at the legendary Abbey Road Studios, ‘Silence, Please’ opens an exciting new chapter in the band’s career. The single ‘Butter My Lover’ already offers a promising taste of what’s to come. From intimate venues to the biggest festival stages, the ‘Silence, Please World Tour’ promises to sweep audiences around the world up in an acoustic whirlwind that is as unrestrained as it is defiant of categorisation. Following spectacular opening sets on The Barn stage at Rock Werchter 2022 and sold-out shows at De Roma, the OLT Rivierenhof and the Ancienne Belgique, The Dead South are set to make a comeback
946F9328CD00D8FDEC39A550E18EB841: AMENRA will return to AB in 2027 for an exclusive series of concerts. These will be the first heavy metal shows of the year for the band from Kortrijk and, at the same time, their only Belgian gigs of 2027. For over twenty years, AMENRA have been developing their own distinctive sound, somewhere between post-metal, doom and sludge. Their music revolves around loss, pain and connection, characterised time and again by that intense alternation between subdued passages and crushing outbursts. Their concerts have since become a fixture at AB, where they have sold out several nights in a row in recent years. With frontman Colin H. Van Eeckhout, stark black-and-white visuals and impressive dynamics, AMENRA continues to deliver a unique live experience every single time.
